items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: The old band director we had, he was very particular about his music... Who was the band director? Edwards.

ctx.x: Who was the band director? Edwards.
Now I've forgotten his first name, because everybody called him Chief, Chief Edwards. He's an old climate player from North Carolina.
Now you were in a segregated unit, right?
